claims.claim: The camera is working perfectly fine.
claims.evidence: No test shots, menu/screen view, or functional checks are shown in the witness photos.
Witness photos show only the camera body and a lens cap; no batteries are shown.

claims.claim: I am selling with a silicone case.
claims.evidence: No silicone case is visible in the witness photos.
Nikon logo is visible on the camera body in the photos.
“D7000” marking is visible on the right side of the camera body in photos 0 and 1.

risks.risk: Unconfirmed functionality (shutter, autofocus, buttons, ports, and overall operation).
risks.proof: A short video showing the camera powered on with LCD/EVF display, menu navigation, and a live view + one test photo saved to the memory card.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used body with unknown working status (worst case: may need service).

risks.risk: Missing lens (photos show only the body and a lens cap; no lens attached).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full lens being included (front element, mount connection, and model/label if present).

risks.risk: Sensor/mirror condition unknown (dust, scratches, fungus, or damage).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the sensor (or a test image of a blank white wall at high f-stop) plus a shot of the mirror/inside view if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential sensor/optics issue risk.

risks.risk: Battery/charger and accessories may be missing or not as claimed.
risks.proof: Photos showing both batteries, charger (if any), and the silicone case laid out next to the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming extra batteries/case are included.

risks.risk: Screen/EVF and physical condition unknown (no clear view of LCD/EVF; cardboard box damage suggests rough handling).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the LCD and EVF with the camera powered on, plus a photo of any visible dents/scratches around the body.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically used with possible wear.

risks.risk: Shutter count/usage history unknown (can affect value and reliability).
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from a shutter count tool or camera info screen showing shutter actuations.

proof_requests: Show the exact lens included (if any): front element + mount connection + model/label.
Power on the camera and record a short video: LCD/EVF on, menu navigation, live view, and one test photo saved.
Provide close-up photos of the sensor (or a high-f-stop test shot of a blank surface) to check dust/scratches.
Show both batteries and the silicone case laid out clearly next to the camera.
Show LCD and EVF close-ups while powered on, and any visible body damage around ports/buttons.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies a Nikon D7000 body, but key value drivers (lens inclusion and confirmed working condition) are not shown. A worst-case body-only, unverified-functionality price is appropriate until the requested proof is provided.
